race.description: Stu Valentine For Bloodstock Insurance 3yo Trotters Mbl
race.comment: FREDIDRIVSAMERCURY (4) went back last start then made a long searching run to score by 1.2 metres at this circuit and distance, the second win from his past four runs. Primary contender. ICONIC IMAGE (3) recorded three straight placings - two behind FREDIDRIVSAMERCURY - before he led and kept finding to salute last start at this circuit and distance. Will enjoy a nice run from this favourable starting position. Major player. DESIRING DIAMONDS (1) broke and finished a distant fourth last time. That continued a run of top-four results and she draws the ace again so if she behaves a big run is likely. DINGANE (5) has been solid in finishing runner-up in both outings since winning here. Respect.
